about: Generator config for the yeslyf seed (PLAN_admin_seed_v01.md, deliverable D1). Every value here shapes the synthetic seed and nothing else; no seed ratio leaks into product logic (no client-data assumptions until a flywheel exists; Vatsal, 11 Sep 2026). Cause labels: 'Vatsal, 22 Sep 2026' is his call in the plan; 'assumption' is a number with no data behind it; 'seed plan, 22 Sep 2026' is a provisional call that Vatsal vetoes by reply. A block with added = 'phase A' is a decision taken while building where the plan was silent; the phase A report lists them. ref names the plan section or the repo source.
